Control Mode Change has failed.

Please perform the steps below to change to Normal Mode.
1.Turn the engine/power switch OFF.

2.Turn the engine/power switch ON(Engine ON/Ready ON).

Do you want to try again?

Increase Line
(FR / FL / RR / RL)

1. Depress and hold the brake pedal.
2. Loosen the bleeder plug.
   (Until air stops coming out)
3. Tighten the bleeder plug.
4. Release the brake pedal.
Repeat steps of 1 to 4 10 times or more.

Perform the following 3 steps.

1.Turn the ignition switch OFF.
Note: Wait for 2 minutes or more after ignition switch OFF. While waiting, please DO NOT press on the brake pedal or open/close the doors.

Perform the following 4 steps.

1.Connect the vinyl tube to the bleeder plug of FL wheel.
2.Depress the brake pedal several times, then loosen the bleeder plug with the pedal held down.

Perform the following 4 steps.

1.Connect the vinyl tube to the bleeder plug of FR wheel.
2.Depress the brake pedal several times, then loosen the bleeder plug with the pedal held down.

Perform the following 4 steps.

1.Connect the vinyl tube to the bleeder plug of FL wheel.
2.Depress the brake pedal several times, then loosen the bleeder plug with the pedal held down.

Perform the following 4 steps.

1.Connect the vinyl tube to the bleeder plug of RL wheel.
2.Depress the brake pedal.

Perform the following 3 steps.

1.Turn the ignition switch OFF.
2.Remove the 2 ABS motor relays.
Note: This procedure is not required if the ABS motor relays are already removed.
3.Turn the ignition switch ON.

Perform the following 4 steps.

1.Connect the vinyl tube to the bleeder plug of FL wheel.
2.Depress the brake pedal several times, then loosen the bleeder plug with the pedal held down.

Perform the following 4 steps.

1.Connect the vinyl tube to the bleeder plug of FR wheel.
2.Depress the brake pedal several times, then loosen the bleeder plug with the pedal held down.

Perform the following 4 steps.

1.Connect the vinyl tube to the bleeder plug of RR wheel.
2.Depress the brake pedal.

1: Depress the brake pedal several times.
2: Loosen the bleeder plug of the FL wheel with the brake pedal held down.
3: After fluid bleeding stops, tighten the bleeder plug of the FL wheel and release the brake pedal.
4: Repeat steps 1 to 3 above until the air or the old fluid stops coming out.

1: Depress the brake pedal several times.
2: Loosen the bleeder plug of the stroke simulator with the brake pedal held down.
3: After fluid bleeding stops, tighten the bleeder plug of the stroke simulator and release the brake pedal.
4: Repeat steps 1 to 3 above until the air stops coming out.

1: Depress the brake pedal several times.
2: Loosen the bleeder plug of the FR wheel with the brake pedal held down.
3: After fluid bleeding stops, tighten the bleeder plug of the FR wheel and release the brake pedal.
4: Repeat steps 1 to 3 above until the air or the old fluid stops coming out.
Learning of Stroke Sensor Zero Point

This function is used to calibrate zero point of the sensor and store system information.

Confirm the following conditions.
- The vehicle is on a flat surface.
- The vehicle is stopped.
- The engine/power switch is ON (Engine OFF/Ready OFF).
- Shift in P
- The steering wheel is centered.

Press Next to proceed.
Learning of Stroke Sensor Zero Point

This function is used to calibrate zero point of the sensor and store system information.

Zero Point of Stroke Sensor Learning Status
Zero Point of G Sensor Learning Status
Zero Point of Yaw Rate Sensor Learning Status

Memorize the steering angle zero point.

Press Next to proceed.
Press Next to proceed after Oil Pressure Sensor Zero Point Learning is complete.

Perform the following operations.

1. Turn the engine/power switch ON (Engine OFF/Ready OFF) with the shift in P.
2. Wait until Oil Pressure Sensor Zero Point Learning is complete. (Approximately 3 to 15 seconds)
(During the learning, the D range light or CVT warning light blinks irregularly.)
(After the learning is complete, the D range light or CVT warning light blinks quickly.)

Note:
If the D range light or CVT warning light does not blink irregularly, turn the engine/power switch OFF and wait for 10 seconds, then turn the engine/power switch ON (Engine OFF/Ready OFF) again.
If it is not complete even after 30 seconds has passed, confirm the following conditions.
- Battery voltage is between 10.5V and 16V.
- CVT oil temperature is between 0 and 100 degrees.
2. Oil Pressure Sensor Zero Point Learning

Line Pressure/Belt Clamping Pressure Learning has failed because Oil Pressure Sensor Zero Point Learning has not been complete.
Please try again.
2. Oil Pressure Sensor Zero Point Learning
3. G Sensor Zero Point Learning
Press Next to start G Sensor Zero Point Learning.
3. G Sensor Zero Point Learning

Perform the following operations.
1. The shift lever is in P and turn the engine/power switch ON (Engine OFF/Ready OFF).
2. Wait until Oil Pressure Sensor Zero Point Learning is  complete. (approximately 3 to 15 seconds)
("D" position light blinks irregularly after the learning is complete.)
Note: 
If the "D" position light does not blink irregularly, turn the engine/power switch OFF and wait for 10 seconds and  then turn the engine/power switch ON (Engine OFF/Ready OFF) again. 
If it is not complete even after 30 seconds has passed, confirm the following conditions.
- Battery voltage is 10V or more.
- CVT Oil temperature is between -5 and 100 degrees.
3. G Sensor Zero Point Learning
